company.name: Vest Financial
company.description:
Vest is driven by the conviction that investors desire more certainty in their investment outcomes. Founded in 2012 to address this market need, Vest’s early investors were Y Combinator, Payment Ventures and First Round Capital. 

In 2016, Vest became an asset management subsidiary of CBOE Holdings, Inc., one of the world’s largest exchange holding companies and owner of the Chicago Board Options Exchange (the largest U.S. options exchange and creator of listed options), the Bats exchanges, CBOE Futures Exchange (CFE) and other subsidiaries. Today CBOE Vest offers institutional-quality target outcome investments built on the backbone of its unique investment philosophy and CBOE’s indexes—that strive to buffer losses, amplify gains or provide consistent income—to a diverse spectrum of investors.

OUR MISSION

Reengineering Investing
Most investments today target speculative returns, with uncertain levels of risk, over an uncertain period. While opportunistic, this approach to investing brings a degree of uncertainty. We are building a new class of investments, called Target Outcome Investments, that target a defined return profile, with an allowance for a specific level risk, at a specific point in time in the future. Such investments strive to provide investors with targeted protection, enhanced returns, or consistent income, with a level of predictability unattainable with most other investments.

productsAndServices.description: A family of derivatives-based investment strategies that define targeted growth, income, and downside-protection parameters for portfolio implementation.
productsAndServices.name: Target Outcome Investments®

productsAndServices.description: An options-based strategy designed to participate in the gains of a reference asset up to a cap while seeking to buffer losses within a defined range over an outcome period.
productsAndServices.name: Target Buffer®

productsAndServices.description: A rules-based options strategy that seeks to generate a predefined level of income by selling calls on part of an underlying portfolio while retaining some growth exposure.
productsAndServices.name: Target Income

productsAndServices.description: A rules-based options strategy designed to enhance positive returns of a reference asset after a specified threshold while seeking to track negative returns approximately one-for-one.
productsAndServices.name: Target Growth

productsAndServices.description: A financing strategy that uses derivatives to provide synthetic borrowing exposure, enabling investors to obtain financing linked to selected reference assets.
productsAndServices.name: Target Financing™

productsAndServices.description: Defined outcome investment solutions for 401(k), pension, and other retirement plans, including buffer strategies implemented through mutual funds and collective investment trusts.
productsAndServices.name: Retirement Solutions
